idea-plugin.name: Erlang
idea-plugin.description:
Erlang support for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, RubyMine and other JetBrains IDE.

Feel free to file new feature requests as an issue on GitHub.

If you find this plugin useful, consider making a donation to support the project.

The plugin can send anonymous usage counts once a day, only if you allow it. See the privacy policy.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Show Usages and Find Usages work from a macro argument that names a function or record (#1492)
  • Remove duplicate export now keeps comments and line breaks in the module's export lists (#1527)
  • Introduce record field no longer breaks records whose fields contain braces, such as tuple or map defaults (#1524)
  • Guards that call ceil, floor, min or max are no longer marked as illegal guard expressions (#1514)
  • Format strings with the map key order modifiers ~kp and ~Kp no longer get an "Invalid control sequence" warning (#1515)
  • The build now compiles a module after its parse transform or behaviour even when that file is very large (#1511)
  • Generate function spec now proposes a return type that covers every clause, such as atom() | tuple() (#1525)
  • and 8 more changes: full list
